name: STIHL MS 251 Wood Boss
blurb: Wood Boss. STIHL's 2025 chart groups it with the MS 250: 3/8″ PICCO .050″ (44–61 drive links, 12″–18″) or .325″ (62 or 68 drive links).
intro: The MS 251 Wood Boss and MS 251 C-BE are named in the same 2025 chain-chart block as the MS 250 and MS 241 C-M. The MS 250 has its own page. This one is the Wood Boss query. STIHL's 2025 chart gives this model block two chain families. 3/8″ PICCO at .050″ gauge runs 44, 50, 55 and 61 drive links on 12″, 14″, 16″ and 18″ bars (63 PM3). .325″ chain is listed at .063″ gauge (26 RM3: 62 links on 16″, 68 on 18″, and the 18″ length has two bar part numbers) and at .050″ gauge on 18″ (23 RM3 68, two bar part numbers). A 16″ saw in this block can be 55 or 62 drive links depending on which bar is fitted. Read the stamp.

sources_note: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog, Saw Chain Selection and Identification (catalog pp. 166–167), read 5 Nov 2026. The chart names the MS 241 C-M, MS 250, MS 251 Wood Boss and MS 251 C-BE as one block. File size on .325″ rows: STIHL's 2025 file table (both 11/64″ and 3/16″) and Oregon's 2020 filing chart (3/16″ for .325″ chain), the Oregon chart as already read for this site on 3 Nov 2026. PICCO rows use STIHL's 5/32″ file for 3/8″ PICCO.
